name: local-weather-dashboard
description: A weather dashboard with live Open-Meteo readings and a deterministic local fallback engine. No API key required.

scripts.build:worker: npx --yes esbuild@0.25.0 worker/index.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=neutral --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/worker.js && rm -rf dist/public && mkdir -p dist/public && cp -R public/. dist/public/ && mv dist/public/index.html dist/public/dashboard.html
